title: Regular-sequence kernels compared with a regular presentation of the completed quotient
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(Q,\mathfrak m_Q)$ be regular local rings [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m_R$ be an ideal, put $B=R/I$, and let $\widehat B=\varprojlim_n B/(\mathfrak m_RB)^n$ be its maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $\pi:Q\to\widehat B$ be a surjective ring homomorphism. Then $I$ is generated by a finite $R$-regular sequence contained in $\mathfrak m_R$ if and only if $\ker\pi$ is generated by a finite $Q$-regular sequence contained in $\mathfrak m_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Empty generating sequences are allowed.

source.place: Tags 09Q1 (lemma-quotient-regular-ring), equivalence (1) and (2), and 09PZ (lemma-ci-well-defined), independence of the regular-local surjection onto a complete Noetherian local ring.

proof.text: Because a regular local ring is Noetherian, $R$ and $Q$ satisfy the Noetherian hypotheses. Since $I\subseteq\mathfrak m_R$, $B=R/I$ is a nonzero local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_R/I$ and the quotient map is local. $B$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-image-noetherian], so its completion $\widehat B$ at $\mathfrak m_B=\mathfrak m_R/I=\mathfrak m_RB$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian], local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_B\widehat B$ by [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-local-ring], and $\mathfrak m_B\widehat B$-adically complete by clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-ideal] ($\mathfrak m_B$ is finitely generated). The same applies to $R$ and $\widehat R$; the canonical surjection $\widehat R\to\widehat B$ and its kernel are the subject of step 2. The given surjection $\pi:Q\to\widehat B$ is local: the preimage of the maximal ideal is a maximal ideal of the local ring $Q$, hence is $\mathfrak m_Q$.

source.place: Tags 05GG, 05GI, 0316 and 0325; local quotient setup in Tag 09Q1

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-completion-regular-kernel-preservation] to $(R,\mathfrak m_R,I)$. It identifies generation of $I$ by an $R$-regular sequence in $\mathfrak m_R$ with generation of the kernel of the canonical surjection $q_0:\widehat R\to\widehat B$ by a $\widehat R$-regular sequence in the maximal ideal. The source $\widehat R$ is regular local by [lem-weil-pbc-completion-regular-local], since $R$ is regular local.

source.place: Tag 09Q1, equivalence (1) and (2), with completion comparison from Tags 00MA and 00MB

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-complete-local-ci-presentation-independence] to the complete Noetherian local ring $A=\widehat B$ and the two surjective local maps $q_0:\widehat R\to A$ and $\pi:Q\to A$. It identifies regular-sequence generation of $\ker q_0$ with regular-sequence generation of $\ker\pi$; the empty sequence is permitted in both kernels.

proof.text: Chaining the equivalence of step 2 with that of step 3 gives exactly the asserted equivalence for $I$ and $\ker\pi$, with both sequences contained in the respective maximal ideals.

lean.statement: theorem regularQuotientCompletionKernelTest {R : Type u} {Q : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing Q] [IsRegularLocalRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing Q] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (π : Q →+* AdicCompletion (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) (R ⧸ I)) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) : (∃ xs : List R, RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R xs ∧ Ideal.ofList xs = I ∧ ∀ x ∈ xs, x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ↔ (∃ ys : List Q, RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular Q ys ∧ Ideal.ofList ys = RingHom.ker π ∧ ∀ y ∈ ys, y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Q)
